# PDF2Emails

> Extract email addresses from any PDF entirely in your browser. No uploads, 100% private.

PDF2Emails is a free-to-start web tool that parses PDF files locally with pdf.js, extracts
every email address, and lets you clean, deduplicate, verify, enrich and export the list to
CSV/Excel. Scanned PDFs are supported via OCR (tesseract.js). Payments are handled by PayPal
and dLocal Go.

## Core facts

- 100% client-side processing; files never leave the device.
- Free extraction for small PDFs; paid unlock for cleaning, verifying and exporting the full list.
- OCR support for scanned PDFs.
- Prices by country: Latin America (dLocal Go) vs rest of world (PayPal).
